Goals.Goal: **Three-value review severity.** ReviewIssueSeverity and ReviewFinding.severity are error, warning, or info. Catalog guides may assign info. No live REVIEW_CATALOG code is assigned info in this bundle. README.md CLI Overview review row names argv token severity.

**Filter.** Argv token severity on review is a minimum threshold: error shows errors only; warning shows error plus warning; info shows all three. Omitted means warning. The filter applies to text and to the JSON findings array. summary is recounted to match the displayed array and gains infos (nested, not a new ReviewResult top-level key).

**Refuse taste.** Values land, hotfix, empty, and any other token are invalid-arguments naming the three accepted values. After the flag exists that refusal is a value check, not Unrecognized argument.

**Detection stays.** review.scope-outside-write-scope and review.write-evidence-outside-scope stay error. review.attempt-pair-identical-tree and review.hunk-uncovered stay warning. A planted undeclared source write still produces review.scope-outside-write-scope. examples/ is unchanged.
